title: चतुरधिकशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 104 · Tenth day: Shikhandin and Arjuna move out

summary.en: Dhritarashtra asks how Shikhandin advanced against Bhishma. At dawn, with Shikhandin in front, the Pandavas march out, and Bhishma tells Duryodhana he will fight and either die or kill.
summary.kn: ಶಿಖಂಡಿ ಭೀಷ್ಮನ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಹೇಗೆ ಮುನ್ನಡೆದನೆಂದು ಧೃತರಾಷ್ಟ್ರ ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಉದಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಶಿಖಂಡಿಯನ್ನು ಮುಂದಿಟ್ಟು ಪಾಂಡವರು ಹೊರಡುತ್ತಾರೆ; ತಾನು ಹೋರಾಡಿ ಸಾಯುವೆ ಅಥವಾ ಕೊಲ್ಲುವೆ ಎಂದು ಭೀಷ್ಮ ದುರ್ಯೋಧನನಿಗೆ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: धृतराष्ट्र पूछते हैं कि शिखण्डी भीष्म के विरुद्ध कैसे बढ़ा। भोर में शिखण्डी को आगे कर पाण्डव निकलते हैं और भीष्म दुर्योधन से कहते हैं कि वे लड़ेंगे और मरेंगे या मारेंगे।
summary.te: శిఖండి భీష్మునిపై ఎలా ముందుకు సాగాడని ధృతరాష్ట్రుడు అడుగుతాడు. ఉదయం శిఖండిని ముందు ఉంచి పాండవులు బయలుదేరతారు; తాను పోరాడి చస్తానో చంపుతానో అని భీష్ముడు దుర్యోధనునికి చెబుతాడు.
summary.ta: சிகண்டி பீஷ்மரை எவ்வாறு எதிர்த்தான் என்று த்ருதராஷ்டிரன் கேட்கிறான். விடியலில் சிகண்டியை முன்வைத்துப் பாண்டவர் புறப்படுகின்றனர்; போரிட்டுச் சாவேன் அல்லது கொல்வேன் என்று பீஷ்மர் துரியோதனனுக்குக் கூறுகிறார்.
summary.ml: ശിഖണ്ഡി ഭീഷ്മരുടെ നേരെ എങ്ങനെ മുന്നേറി എന്ന് ധൃതരാഷ്ട്രർ ചോദിക്കുന്നു. പ്രഭാതത്തിൽ ശിഖണ്ഡിയെ മുന്നിൽ നിർത്തി പാണ്ഡവർ പുറപ്പെടുന്നു; ഒന്നുകിൽ മരിക്കുകയോ കൊല്ലുകയോ ചെയ്യുമെന്ന് ഭീഷ്മർ ദുര്യോധനനോട് പറയുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 6.104; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Jul 26 2021

verses.text: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच

meaning.en: Dhritarashtra said:

verses.text:
कथं शिखण्डी गाङ्गेयमभ्यवर्तत संयुगे ।
पाण्डवाश्च तथा भीष्मं तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय ॥

meaning.en: Sanjaya, tell me how Shikhandin advanced against the son of Ganga in the battle, and how the Pandavas did.

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
ततः प्रभाते विमले सूर्यस्योदयनं प्रति ।
वाद्यमानासु भेरीषु मृदङ्गेष्वानकेषु च ॥

meaning.en: Then, in the clear dawn, as the sun was about to rise, with kettledrums, mridangas, and anakas sounding,

verses.text:
ध्मायत्सु दधिवर्णेषु जलजेषु समन्ततः ।
शिखण्डिनं पुरस्कृत्य निर्याताः पाण्डवा युधि ॥

meaning.en: and curd-white conches blowing on every side, the Pandavas marched out to battle with Shikhandin in front.

verses.text:
कृत्वा व्यूहं महाराज सर्वशत्रुनिबर्हणम् ।
शिखण्डी सर्वसैन्यानामग्र आसीद्विशां पते ॥

meaning.en: Having formed an array, great king, that destroyed all enemies, Shikhandin, lord of the people, was at the head of all the armies.

verses.text:
चक्ररक्षौ ततस्तस्य भीमसेनधनंजयौ ।
पृष्ठतो द्रौपदेयाश्च सौभद्रश्चैव वीर्यवान् ॥

meaning.en: Bhimasena and Dhananjaya were the guardians of his wheels; behind him came the sons of Draupadi and mighty Abhimanyu.

verses.text:
सात्यकिश्चेकितानश्च तेषां गोप्ता महारथः ।
धृष्टद्युम्नस्ततः पश्चात्पाञ्चालैरभिरक्षितः ॥

meaning.en: The great chariot-warriors Satyaki and Chekitana protected them; behind them Dhrishtadyumna, guarded by the Panchalas.

verses.text:
ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा यमाभ्यां सहितः प्रभुः ।
प्रययौ सिंहनादेन नादयन्भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: Then King Yudhishthira, the lord, with the twins, went on, filling the air with lion-roars, bull of the Bharatas.

verses.text:
विराटस्तु ततः पश्चात्स्वेन सैन्येन संवृतः ।
द्रुपदश्च महाराज ततः पश्चादुपाद्रवत् ॥

meaning.en: Behind him came Virata, surrounded by his own army, and behind him again, great king, Drupada charged.

verses.text:
केकया भ्रातरः पञ्च धृष्टकेतुश्च वीर्यवान् ।
जघनं पालयामास पाण्डुसैन्यस्य भारत ॥

meaning.en: The five Kekaya brothers and valiant Dhrishtaketu guarded the rear of the Pandava army, Bharata.

verses.text:
एवं व्यूह्य महत्सैन्यं पाण्डवास्तव वाहिनीम् ।
अभ्यद्रवन्त संग्रामे त्यक्त्वा जीवितमात्मनः ॥

meaning.en: Having thus drawn up their great army, the Pandavas, staking their own lives, rushed at your force in the battle.

verses.text:
तथैव कुरवो राजन्भीष्मं कृत्वा महाबलम् ।
अग्रतः सर्वसैन्यानां प्रययुः पाण्डवान्प्रति ॥

meaning.en: In the same way the Kurus, putting mighty Bhishma at the head of all the armies, advanced against the Pandavas.

verses.text:
पुत्रैस्तव दुराधर्षै रक्षितः सुमहाबलैः ।
ततो द्रोणो महेष्वासः पुत्रश्चास्य महारथः ॥

meaning.en: He was guarded by your invincible and very mighty sons; behind them came the great archer Drona and his son, a great chariot-warrior.

verses.text:
भगदत्तस्ततः पश्चाद्गजानीकेन संवृतः ।
कृपश्च कृतवर्मा च भगदत्तमनुव्रतौ ॥

meaning.en: Behind them came Bhagadatta, surrounded by a troop of elephants, and Kripa and Kritavarman followed Bhagadatta.

verses.text:
काम्बोजराजो बलवांस्ततः पश्चात्सुदक्षिणः ।
मागधश्च जयत्सेनः सौबलश्च बृहद्बलः ॥

meaning.en: Then the mighty king of the Kambojas, Sudakshina, came behind, and Jayatsena of Magadha, and Brihadbala son of Subala.

verses.text:
तथेतरे महेष्वासाः सुशर्मप्रमुखा नृपाः ।
जघनं पालयामासुस्तव सैन्यस्य भारत ॥

meaning.en: And other great archers, kings led by Susharman, guarded the rear of your army, Bharata.

verses.text:
दिवसे दिवसे प्राप्ते भीष्मः शांतनवो युधि ।
आसुरानकरोद्व्यूहान्पैशाचानथ राक्षसान् ॥

meaning.en: Day after day, Bhishma son of Shantanu would draw up arrays in the battle of the asura, pishacha, and rakshasa kinds.

verses.text:
ततः प्रववृते युद्धं तव तेषां च भारत ।
अन्योन्यं निघ्नतां राजन्यमराष्ट्रविवर्धनम् ॥

meaning.en: Then a battle began between your men and theirs, Bharata, as they struck one another, swelling the realm of Yama.

verses.text:
अर्जुनप्रमुखाः पार्थाः पुरस्कृत्य शिखण्डिनम् ।
भीष्मं युद्धेऽभ्यवर्तन्त किरन्तो विविधाञ्शरान् ॥

meaning.en: The Parthas, led by Arjuna and putting Shikhandin in front, advanced on Bhishma in the battle, scattering arrows of many kinds.

verses.text:
तत्र भारत भीमेन पीडितास्तावकाः शरैः ।
रुधिरौघपरिक्लिन्नाः परलोकं ययुस्तदा ॥

meaning.en: There, Bharata, your men, tormented by Bhima's arrows and drenched in floods of blood, went to the other world.

verses.text:
नकुलः सहदेवश्च सात्यकिश्च महारथः ।
तव सैन्यं समासाद्य पीडयामासुरोजसा ॥

meaning.en: Nakula, Sahadeva, and the great chariot-warrior Satyaki, closing with your army, tormented it with their might.

verses.text:
ते वध्यमानाः समरे तावका भरतर्षभ ।
नाशक्नुवन्वारयितुं पाण्डवानां महद्बलम् ॥

meaning.en: Struck down in the battle, those men of yours, bull of the Bharatas, could not hold back the great force of the Pandavas.

verses.text:
ततस्तु तावकं सैन्यं वध्यमानं समन्ततः ।
संप्राद्रवद्दिशो राजन्काल्यमानं महारथैः ॥

meaning.en: Then your army, slaughtered on every side, fled in all directions, O king, driven by the great chariot-warriors.

verses.text:
त्रातारं नाध्यगच्छन्त तावका भरतर्षभ ।
वध्यमानाः शितैर्बाणैः पाण्डवैः सहसृञ्जयैः ॥

meaning.en: Your men, struck by the sharp arrows of the Pandavas and Srinjayas, found no protector, bull of the Bharatas.

verses.text: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच

meaning.en: Dhritarashtra said:

verses.text:
पीड्यमानं बलं पार्थैर्दृष्ट्वा भीष्मः पराक्रमी ।
यदकार्षीद्रणे क्रुद्धस्तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the army tormented by the Parthas, Sanjaya, tell me what the valiant Bhishma did in his anger in the battle.

verses.text:
कथं वा पाण्डवान्युद्धे प्रत्युद्यातः परंतपः ।
विनिघ्नन्सोमकान्वीरांस्तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय ॥

meaning.en: And how did that scorcher of foes go against the Pandavas, killing the heroic Somakas? Tell me that, Sanjaya.

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
आचक्षे ते महाराज यदकार्षीत्पितामहः ।
पीडिते तव पुत्रस्य सैन्ये पाण्डवसृञ्जयैः ॥

meaning.en: I will tell you, great king, what the grandsire did when your son's army was being tormented by the Pandavas and Srinjayas.

verses.text:
प्रहृष्टमनसः शूराः पाण्डवाः पाण्डुपूर्वज ।
अभ्यवर्तन्त निघ्नन्तस्तव पुत्रस्य वाहिनीम् ॥

meaning.en: The heroic Pandavas, elder brother of Pandu, with glad hearts, advanced, killing the army of your son.

verses.text:
तं विनाशं मनुष्येन्द्र नरवारणवाजिनाम् ।
नामृष्यत तदा भीष्मः सैन्यघातं रणे परैः ॥

meaning.en: Bhishma, lord of men, could not bear that destruction of men, elephants, and horses, that slaughter of his army by the enemy.

verses.text:
स पाण्डवान्महेष्वासः पाञ्चालांश्च ससृञ्जयान् ।
अभ्यद्रवत दुर्धर्षस्त्यक्त्वा जीवितमात्मनः ॥

meaning.en: That great archer, unassailable, rushed at the Pandavas, Panchalas, and Srinjayas, giving up his own life.

verses.text:
स पाण्डवानां प्रवरान्पञ्च राजन्महारथान् ।
आत्तशस्त्रान्रणे यत्तान्वारयामास सायकैः ।
नाराचैर्वत्सदन्तैश्च शितैरञ्जलिकैस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: He held back with arrows five of the foremost great chariot-warriors of the Pandavas, who were armed and eager in the battle, with narachas, vatsadantas, and sharp anjalikas.

verses.text:
निजघ्ने समरे क्रुद्धो हस्त्यश्वममितं बहु ।
रथिनोऽपातयद्राजन्रथेभ्यः पुरुषर्षभः ॥

meaning.en: Enraged in the battle, he killed countless elephants and horses, and, O king, that bull among men brought down charioteers from their chariots,

verses.text:
सादिनश्चाश्वपृष्ठेभ्यः पदातींश्च समागतान् ।
गजारोहान्गजेभ्यश्च परेषां विदधद्भयम् ॥

meaning.en: horsemen from horses' backs, foot-soldiers who came up, and elephant-riders from their elephants, spreading terror among the enemy.

verses.text:
तमेकं समरे भीष्मं त्वरमाणं महारथम् ।
पाण्डवाः समवर्तन्त वज्रपाणिमिवासुराः ॥

meaning.en: The Pandavas closed in on him alone, that great chariot-warrior Bhishma, hurrying in the battle, as demons close in on the thunderbolt-wielder.

verses.text:
शक्राशनिसमस्पर्शान्विमुञ्चन्निशिताञ्शरान् ।
दिक्ष्वदृश्यत सर्वासु घोरं संधारयन्वपुः ॥

meaning.en: Loosing sharp arrows whose touch was like Indra's thunderbolt, he was seen in all directions, bearing a terrible form.

verses.text:
मण्डलीकृतमेवास्य नित्यं धनुरदृश्यत ।
संग्रामे युध्यमानस्य शक्रचापनिभं महत् ॥

meaning.en: His great bow, ever drawn in a circle, was seen as he fought in the battle, like Indra's rainbow.

verses.text:
तद्दृष्ट्वा समरे कर्म तव पुत्रा विशां पते ।
विस्मयं परमं प्राप्ताः पितामहमपूजयन् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing that deed in the battle, your sons, lord of the people, were struck with the greatest wonder and honoured the grandsire.

verses.text:
पार्था विमनसो भूत्वा प्रैक्षन्त पितरं तव ।
युध्यमानं रणे शूरं विप्रचित्तिमिवामराः ।
न चैनं वारयामासुर्व्यात्ताननमिवान्तकम् ॥

meaning.en: The Parthas, dejected, watched your father, the hero fighting in the battle like Viprachitti among the immortals, and could not hold him back, as he was like Death with open mouth.

verses.text:
दशमेऽहनि संप्राप्ते रथानीकं शिखण्डिनः ।
अदहन्निशितैर्बाणैः कृष्णवर्त्मेव काननम् ॥

meaning.en: When the tenth day came, he burned up Shikhandin's host of chariots with sharp arrows, like fire in a forest.

verses.text:
तं शिखण्डी त्रिभिर्बाणैरभ्यविध्यत्स्तनान्तरे ।
आशीविषमिव क्रुद्धं कालसृष्टमिवान्तकम् ॥

meaning.en: Shikhandin pierced him between the breasts with three arrows, as if piercing an enraged venomous snake or Death sent by Time.

verses.text:
स तेनातिभृशं विद्धः प्रेक्ष्य भीष्मः शिखण्डिनम् ।
अनिच्छन्नपि संक्रुद्धः प्रहसन्निदमब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Hard struck by him, Bhishma looked at Shikhandin and, very angry though unwilling to fight him, said, laughing:

verses.text:
काममभ्यस वा मा वा न त्वां योत्स्ये कथंचन ।
यैव हि त्वं कृता धात्रा सैव हि त्वं शिखण्डिनी ॥

meaning.en: "Strike me, or do not; I will not fight you in any way. For you are Shikhandini, just as the Creator made you."

verses.text:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा शिखण्डी क्रोधमूर्छितः ।
उवाच भीष्मं समरे सृक्किणी परिलेलिहन् ॥

meaning.en: Hearing his words, Shikhandin, shaking with rage, licking the corners of his mouth, said to Bhishma in the battle:

verses.text:
जानामि त्वां महाबाहो क्षत्रियाणां क्षयंकरम् ।
मया श्रुतं च ते युद्धं जामदग्न्येन वै सह ॥

meaning.en: "I know you, mighty-armed one, as the destroyer of the Kshatriyas. I have heard of your fight with Jamadagni's son.

verses.text:
दिव्यश्च ते प्रभावोऽयं स मया बहुशः श्रुतः ।
जानन्नपि प्रभावं ते योत्स्येऽद्याहं त्वया सह ॥

meaning.en: I have heard many times of your divine power; knowing your power, I shall still fight you today.

verses.text:
पाण्डवानां प्रियं कुर्वन्नात्मनश्च नरोत्तम ।
अद्य त्वा योधयिष्यामि रणे पुरुषसत्तम ॥

meaning.en: Best of men, to do good for the Pandavas and for myself, I will fight you today in the battle, best of men.

verses.text:
ध्रुवं च त्वा हनिष्यामि शपे सत्येन तेऽग्रतः ।
एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचो मह्यं यत्क्षमं तत्समाचर ॥

meaning.en: I will surely kill you; I swear it by truth before you. Having heard my words, do what is fitting.

verses.text:
काममभ्यस वा मा वा न मे जीवन्विमोक्ष्यसे ।
सुदृष्टः क्रियतां भीष्म लोकोऽयं समितिंजय ॥

meaning.en: Strike or do not; you will not get away from me alive. Look well at this world, Bhishma, conqueror in battle."

verses.text:
एवमुक्त्वा ततो भीष्मं पञ्चभिर्नतपर्वभिः ।
अविध्यत रणे राजन्प्रणुन्नं वाक्यसायकैः ॥

meaning.en: Having spoken so, he struck Bhishma in the battle with five straight-jointed arrows, great king, driving him on with the arrows of his words.

verses.text:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सव्यसाची परंतपः ।
कालोऽयमिति संचिन्त्य शिखण्डिनमचोदयत् ॥

meaning.en: Hearing those words, Savyasachin, scorcher of foes, thinking, "This is the moment," urged Shikhandin on.

verses.text:
अहं त्वामनुयास्यामि परान्विद्रावयञ्शरैः ।
अभिद्रव सुसंरब्धो भीष्मं भीमपराक्रमम् ॥

meaning.en: "I shall follow you, scattering the enemy with arrows. Rush on Bhishma, of terrible prowess, in full fury.

verses.text:
न हि ते संयुगे पीडां शक्तः कर्तुं महाबलः ।
तस्मादद्य महाबाहो वीर भीष्ममभिद्रव ॥

meaning.en: Mighty though he is, he cannot hurt you in the battle. Therefore, mighty-armed hero, rush at Bhishma today.

verses.text:
अहत्वा समरे भीष्मं यदि यास्यसि मारिष ।
अवहास्योऽस्य लोकस्य भविष्यसि मया सह ॥

meaning.en: If you go away without killing Bhishma in the battle, my lord, you will be a laughing-stock of this world, and I with you.

verses.text:
नावहास्या यथा वीर भवेम परमाहवे ।
तथा कुरु रणे यत्नं साधयस्व पितामहम् ॥

meaning.en: Strive in the battle so that we are not laughed at in this great fight, hero; accomplish the grandsire's fall.

verses.text:
अहं ते रक्षणं युद्धे करिष्यामि परंतप ।
वारयन्रथिनः सर्वान्साधयस्व पितामहम् ॥

meaning.en: I will protect you in the battle, scorcher of foes. Holding back all the chariot-warriors, accomplish the grandsire's fall.

verses.text:
द्रोणं च द्रोणपुत्रं च कृपं चाथ सुयोधनम् ।
चित्रसेनं विकर्णं च सैन्धवं च जयद्रथम् ॥

meaning.en: Drona and Drona's son, Kripa, Suyodhana, Chitrasena, Vikarna, Saindhava Jayadratha,

verses.text:
विन्दानुविन्दावावन्त्यौ काम्बोजं च सुदक्षिणम् ।
भगदत्तं तथा शूरं मागधं च महारथम् ॥

meaning.en: the two Avantis Vinda and Anuvinda, Sudakshina of the Kambojas, the brave Bhagadatta, and the great chariot-warrior of Magadha,

verses.text:
सौमदत्तिं रणे शूरमार्श्यशृङ्गिं च राक्षसम् ।
त्रिगर्तराजं च रणे सह सर्वैर्महारथैः ।
अहमावारयिष्यामि वेलेव मकरालयम् ॥

meaning.en: Somadatta's son, the brave Rishyashringa's son the rakshasa, and the king of the Trigartas with all the great chariot-warriors, I shall hold back in the battle, as the shore holds the sea.

verses.text:
कुरूंश्च सहितान्सर्वान्ये चैषां सैनिकाः स्थिताः ।
निवारयिष्यामि रणे साधयस्व पितामहम् ॥

meaning.en: And all the Kurus together and the soldiers who stand with them I shall check in the battle. Accomplish the grandsire's fall."
